conflicts.fact: Whether moss has true stems and leaves
conflicts.versions: Lesson 2 model-building describes moss as having 'no true roots, stem or leaves' and the observation step refers to 'stem-like' and 'leaf-like' structures. Lesson 3 says moss has 'no true roots and no vascular tissue' and Lesson 4's key couplet uses 'no true roots, stems or leaves' versus 'true roots, stems and leaves' for moss. This is consistent with Lesson 3 only if stems/leaves are absent, but Lesson 2 elsewhere has learners ask whether the leaf-like structures have veins and are 'thin, one cell thick', which is not an actual conflict.

conflicts.fact: Number and identity of animals in the school collection and animal sets used
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 lists 13 organisms with 7 animals (mosquito, butterfly, earthworm, snail, chicken, lizard, goat). Lesson 5 says 'the eight animals' and adds tilapia/omena and grasshopper; Lesson 5 predict phase lists seven plus tilapia or omena; Lesson 6 predicts with 7 animals; Lesson 7 uses '8 animal cards' with 'tilapia or goat', ambiguous whether goat is included.

conflicts.fact: Whether the sukuma wiki is part of the original collection and key plants
conflicts.versions: Lesson 4 identifies maize, bean, grass, fern, moss and sukuma wiki as the six plants for the key, while the phenomenon and Lesson 8 list only maize, bean, grass, fern, moss (mushroom) with no sukuma wiki; Lesson 8 adds sisal and cypress/pine cards.

conflicts.fact: Which lessons the Lesson 1 model is revised in
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 says models are kept for revision in Lessons 4 and 8, but models are revised in every lesson (2, 3, 5, 6, 7), and Lesson 4 says models were revised in Lessons 1-3.

conflicts.fact: Which lesson answers the DQB question about viruses/ Lesson 7 content list vs Lesson 8 omission, and Lesson 8 classification of the mushroom
conflicts.versions: Lesson 3 leaves mushroom unresolved 'for later lessons on kingdoms' but no lesson teaches kingdoms or fungi; Lesson 8 asks learners to sort all organisms into Kingdom Plantae and Animalia while also asking 'why does the mushroom not fit Plantae?', implying a fungi category never taught.
Lesson 7 uses 12 seconds, 10 seconds and 15 seconds wait times in different places, while all other lessons use 10-15 seconds.
